desc: Ideation and core lemmas: answer ≤ side for k≥4; for D≤side, Manhattan compatibility is equivalent to circular perimeter compatibility.
Implement and verify the perimeter greedy binary-search solution on the provided examples and edge cases (corners, side=1, all points on one side, n=k, sparse points).
Confirm complexity O(n log n + n k log side) and integer bounds.
